name: What permits are needed for a garage conversion in Pacifica or Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are needed for a garage conversion in Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a garage conversion in cities like Pacifica or Daly City, you will typically need several permits, including building permits for structural changes, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits. If the conversion creates an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), additional planning and zoning approvals will be required to ensure compliance with local ordinances. The specific requirements can vary slightly between municipalities, so it's crucial to consult with the local planning department or a contractor familiar with Bay Area regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions in Pacifica or Daly City require building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits. ADU conversions also need planning and zoning approvals.
